evidence: Workbook Quality Checks row 49 (check 48) asks that every dimension prompt describe this app without sibling-task residue; the applicable Internal Quality Checks row has no additional annotation. The public instruction.md:1-5 requests a no-sign-in JavaScript/complete-HTML playground at /; environment/instructions/overview.md:3-6 identifies its editor, preview, console and shared snippet library, and policy.md:3 confirms no accounts. All five frozen prompt.md files begin with 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000' (line 1), consistent with integration.md:3. Render judge.toml:23 tests authored editing and Run; constraints judge.toml:23,32 tests the custom surface and shared saved record; functional judge.toml:23-221 tests editor, preview, persistence and history; polish judge.toml:23,32 and visual judge.toml:24,34,44 refer to those same controls and surfaces. No injected criterion or prompt names a sign-in account, sibling product, foreign entity, or incompatible deliverable. The template's generic sign-in wording is absent from the frozen task prompts. A static shell carrying the Colderwater name might superficially satisfy a title-only prompt, but render judge.toml:23 requires authored button interaction and constraints judge.toml:32 requires a cross-context saved-record readback. A conforming no-account canvas editor with different route names remains admissible because controls are found by purpose and the public notes leave routes open (policy.md:3). This is a source review of prompt accuracy, not a live judge result.
